messages:
alex.m: Heads-up — seeing non-deterministic perf variance between replay harness and synthetic load on the A100 pool. Synthetic runs are stable, replay shows ~+9% p50 and occasional tail spikes. Kernel selector flips between matmul_v1 and matmul_v2 depending on tiny env diffs. Posting quick traces and hypotheses.

maya: which driver/image combos are we comparing?

alex.m: repro notes: replay vs synth on same model (redwood/gptq-7b), seq_len=1024, batch=8. Observed selector path: matmul_v1 -> matmul_v2 for some replays. Envs: CUDA 12.1 + driver 535.86 + image gcr/redwood/inference:prod-2026-02-09 vs CUDA 12.2 + driver 550.30 + image prod-2026-02-12. Quick excerpt: 

```text
KERNEL_SELECT: matmul_v1 -> matmul_v2 (seq_len=1024 batch=8)
CUDA: 12.1.105
DRIVER: 535.86
IMAGE: prod-2026-02-09
WALL_MS: 4.12 -> 4.53 (+9.8%)
```

ryan_p: sounds like selector heuristics hitting a different workspace / sm availability threshold. cudnn / cutlass micro-kernel diffs between 12.1/12.2 could shift which kernel is chosen. Also check env flags that change numerics (e.g., REDWOOD_KERNEL_FLAGS).

sasha_k: actionable plan: run a 3x matrix: (A) synth on image A, (B) replay on image A, (C) replay on image B (driver 550). Collect nsight/metrics and our internal kernel selection logs. Keep configs pinned except one variable per run so it's apples-to-apples.

jordan: don't forget KV-cache warmup differences — replay usually starts with cold KV if the prefix history isn't matched. That can change runtime profile and trigger different batching behavior. Match warmup length between synth/replay.

alex.m: did that: forcing KV warmup to full-prefix cut p50 delta down to ~2%, but tail spikes remain on driver 535. So warmup explains some but not all.

maya: for true apples-to-apples we need same container + driver + kernel flags. Also try forcing kernel override to isolate selector impact (force matmul_v1).

ryan_p: command to force selector locally: 

```bash
export REDWOOD_KERNEL_OVERRIDE=matmul_v1
./tools/run_loadtest --harness replay --trace-kernel-select
```

sasha_k: also plan a short H100 run to see cross-arch variance. If matmul_v2 is optimized for newer sm, that'd explain regression on A100.

infra-bot: scheduled job 1871234599 on pool a100-stable with tags [cuda:12.1 driver:535] — logs will be uploaded to gs://redwood-perf/1871234599/

alex.m: next steps (assigned):
1) ryan_p: run forced-kernel experiments on both drivers (535 vs 550) and attach nsight captures.
2) sasha_k: run H100 comparison and upload traces.
3) maya: audit REDWOOD_KERNEL_FLAGS and release notes between prod images.
4) jordan: finalize warmup policy to match replay and synth harness semantics.
I'll gather results and we can decide whether to update kernel heuristics or pin a safe default. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
